biotools.summary: BayesNF is a statistical model and open-source software package for scalable spatiotemporal prediction, utilizing a deep neural network architecture and hierarchical Bayesian inference. It's designed for data-analysis tasks like forecasting and interpolation and can be run on GPU and TPU accelerators.
